verdicts.text: Phases 1–2 adopted: all 50 sentences WER 29.2% → 24.1%, tone 7.7 → 5.5 dB off 2c.
Phase 3 adopted: WER 22.6% on all 50; the paragraph 2 words of 53.
The stops rebuilt (transitions from each place, a velar pinch, bursts and breath by place): 19.7% on all 50, 18.4% on the 30 never tuned on. Adopted.
Phase 4 NOT adopted: it learned the 20 tuning sentences (22% → 16%) and lost on the other 30 (18.4% → 23%). Overfit: fine-grained moves on too little data.
